hop_glosses: Hop 1 identifies the town via the Sherman Hill Summit approach; hop 2 supplies the monument the town gives access to.

sufficient_sets.text: The town is along the eastern approach to Sherman Hill Summit, the highest point along all of the transcontinental Interstate 80, Lincoln Highway and the Overland Route.
Buford is also an access to reach the Ames Monument, which marks the highest point along the original routing of the First transcontinental railroad.
